book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: On the sixth voyage, the captain lost his way.

sentences.ar: السفينة راحت على جبل عالي بالبحر.
sentences.en: The ship went onto a high mountain in the sea.

sentences.ar: حول الجبل كان في سفن مكسورة كتيرة.
sentences.en: Around the mountain there were many broken ships.
And bones of people who never went home.

sentences.ar: كل اللي معي ماتوا بالأيام الأولى.
sentences.en: Everyone with me died in the first days.
I was left alone among the rocks and the cold.
